capture.zh: SPT面板选择螺旋星系→斯图尔特，在南瓜星藏宝密室挑战；打败获得斯图尔特精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 光、暗影、次元系2倍克制，光系不吃超能技能：光系强化单挑流，或自爆+克制系大招强攻流。作者评价「异常好打」。

engine_notes: foe_stage_each_turn: the player's active pet loses 1 speed stage every turn.
immune_pct_damage: 海洋之心 and other 'lose X% of current/max HP' (大比例扣血) skills deal no damage / miss against this boss (ops pct_damage, and 同生共死-style HP-equalising scripts).
infinite_pp: the boss's skills never run out of PP (players could not win by 耗PP).
HP conflict: 4399 pet page says 10000体力, the detailed 4399 guide says 12000体力 (used here).
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
source_note: 4399 guide 2012-10-26: 12000体力 (pet page: 10000), 天生攻击+2, 每回合我方速度-1, PP无限.
